answer:
To dispute TX-0401 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-20), I first need to know what happened so I can pick the right reason code. Eligibility depends on that code.

Which of these describes your situation?

1. **Duplicate charge:** You were charged more than once for the same purchase. TX-0402 (EUR 240.00, TechMart Online, 2026-07-14) has the same amount and merchant, so this may apply if you only made one purchase.
2. **Unauthorized debit:** You did not make or approve this payment.
3. **Card-not-present fraud:** Someone used your card details online without your permission.
4. **Goods not received:** You paid for something that was never delivered.
5. **Service not rendered:** You paid for a service that was never provided.

Once you tell me which applies, I will run the eligibility check, including the dispute window, and report the result. I will open a dispute only if it is eligible and you explicitly confirm.
